Bapt. * Full text (80 Ko) * Red and blue only (50 Ko) * Red only

   

MIND. [1] [Bapt.]
Stupor ; falls asleep while being spoken to, or answering ; heavy sleep until aroused ; awakes only to again fall asleep in the midst of his answer, which he vainly endeavors to finish. θ Typhus.
Confusion of ideas ; confused as if drunk.
Cannot go to sleep, because he cannot get himself together. θ Orchitis. θ Typhoid.
Feels scattered about, and tosses about to get the pieces together. θ Typhus.
Delirium, especially at night, or constant, low ; stupor. θ Typhus.
Indisposed to think, want of power ; mind seems weak.
Aversion to mental or bodily exertion, or to hear conversation about sickness or injuries ; feeble mind ; fretful. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Bapt.]
Dull, bruised feeling in occiput. θ Diphtheria.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Bapt.]
Delirium with almost complete deafness. θ Diphtheria.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Bapt.]
Sensation of great fulness, œdematous swelling of affected parts, especially in choanæ. θ Diphtheria.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Bapt.]
Sordes on teeth and lips ; tongue ulcerated. θ Typhus.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Bapt.]
Aphthæ. θ Typhus.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Bapt.]
Pain and soreness of fauces. θ Diphtheria.
Fauces dark red ; dark, putrid ulcers ; tonsils and parotids swollen ; unusual absence of pain. θ Diphtheria. θ Putrid sore throat, etc. θ Typhus. θ Variola.
Tonsils and soft palate swollen, with constant inclination to swallow, not accompanied by pain. θ Diphtheria.
Tonsils and soft palate very red, but not painful.
Œsophagus feels as if constricted from above down to stomach ; can only swallow water.
Can swallow liquids only ; least solid food gags. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus. θ Diarrhœa.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Bapt.]
Right iliac region sensitive. θ Typhus.
Abdominal muscles sore on pressure, with acute intermitting pain. θ Typhus.
Abdominal tenderness, with flatulency ; 10th day. θ Typhus.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Bapt.]
Fetid, exhausting diarrhœa, causing excoriation.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Bapt.]
Urine alkaline, fetid. θ Typhus.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Bapt.]
Pulse accelerated or slower than in health. θ Diphtheria.
   

NERVES. [36] [Bapt.]
Great languor ; wants to lie down.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Bapt.]
Drowsy, stupid, tired feeling ; disposition to half close eyes.
Delirious stupor : falls asleep while answering a question or while being talked to.
Cannot sleep ; head or body feels scattered about bed ; tosses about to get pieces together. θ Typhus and other diseases.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Bapt.]
Great aversion to open air. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus.
   

FEVER. [40] [Bapt.]
Chilly all day ; whole body feels sore.
Beginning of typhus, when so-called nervous symptoms predominate.
Cerebral forms, especially with excessive drowsiness, delirium, confusion of ideas, stupefying headache ; restless sleep, head feels scattered about ; frightful dreams ; great debility and nervous prostration, with erethism, etc.
Typhoid and cerebral forms of fever ; delirium, drowsiness, confusion, gives slow answer or falls asleep attempting a reply ; erethism ; tries to escape from bed ; sleepless because she cannot get herself together ; head feels scattered, and she tosses about to get pieces together ; sensation of a second self outside of patient ; indifferent ; low delirium, stupor ; sordes on teeth ; face dark, besotted looking ; hearing dull ; epistaxis ; involuntary, scanty stool ; difficult breathing ; fever increases each afternoon.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bapt.]
Prostration with disposition of fluids to decompose.
Discharges and exhalations fetid ; breath, stools, urine, sweat, ulcers.
Ulceration of mucous membranes, especially those of mouth ; also with tendency to putrescence.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bapt.]
Gangrenous sores, aphthæ, sore nipples (locally).
